digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler apply batch drift tolerance testing
propositions: Real _apply_batch continue path is never tested with injected drift commit; only raise path is currently driven
Two structural tests (hasattr check and inspect.getsource substring check) are redundant and should be deleted
New behavioral tests must inject HEAD changes between mutations and verify benign vs competing drift tolerance with real git fixture
Behavioral tests must cover unrelated-ticket commits, same-ticket edits/deletes, sequential benign commits, competing pass_record commits causing abort, and subject-lookup failures
Manifest and mutations_completed count must be correct after mid-pass abort due to competing drift
